title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (AI & NLP)
description:
Apex AI Labs is seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to lead the design and deployment of cutting-edge NLP, RAG, and LLM solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
- Build, fine-tune, and deploy transformer-based deep learning models using PyTorch, Hugging Face, and spaCy.
- Architect production RAG systems using vector databases such as pgvector or FAISS.
- Develop scalable backend REST APIs using FastAPI and Python in Docker containers.
- Deploy ML services on AWS infrastructure with robust CI/CD integration.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate NLP models into enterprise applications.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and NLP.
- Expert proficiency in Python, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, and Hugging Face Transformers.
- Solid experience building backend services with FastAPI, REST APIs, and Docker.
- Experience with PostgreSQL, Vector Databases (pgvector), and AWS (EC2, S3).
- Experience with Kubernetes and Terraform is a strong plus.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI, or related quantitative field.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python / FastAPI)
description:
Nexus Infrastructure is hiring a Backend Engineer to build resilient microservices and data pipelines.

Responsibilities:
- Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices using FastAPI, Python, and SQLAlchemy.
- Optimize database queries and schema designs in PostgreSQL and Redis caching layers.
- Deploy containerized services using Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS.
- Implement automated unit tests and CI/CD pipelines.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of software engineering experience focusing on backend development with Python.
- Strong expertise in FastAPI, Django or Flask, REST APIs, and SQL.
- Mastery of PostgreSQL, database query tuning, and SQLAlchemy.
- Hands-on experience with Docker, Linux, Git, and CI/CD tools.
- Knowledge of Kubernetes and AWS cloud infrastructure.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
DataPulse Tech is looking for a Data Analyst to turn data into strategic insights.

Responsibilities:
- Query complex enterprise databases using advanced SQL.
- Build data pipelines and analytics scripts in Python using Pandas and NumPy.
- Develop interactive dashboards using Tableau or Power BI.
- Collaborate with product managers and business stakeholders.

Requirements:
- 2+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or reporting.
- Expert knowledge of SQL, PostgreSQL, and relational database querying.
- Proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn).
- Strong expertise in data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI).
- Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or Computer Science.
